title: MV Yanfly Message Core Name Box and Triacontane Window Back Image don't work together in MV ?

posts.author: AkiJaline
posts.body:
Hello, this is my first post I make in the forum (english is not my main language, my apologies if you see a typo). I'm using Yanfly Message Core to add a name box for each window text box in RPG Maker MV. The thing is I'm also using Triacontane WindowBackImage.js to add custom background (images) for windows boxes, but for some reason, it doesn't work on Yanfly Name box.
As you can see in my game, Triacontane's WindowBackImage is working on the textbox with a picture using "Windows_Message" on WindowClass, but it's not working on Yanfly's Namebox ("Liria" text is just an edited version of Window.png on System, not a custom image). Is there a way to fix this and make it work? Maybe is Triacontane's plugin not compatible with Yanfly Message Core? Or maybe is there another plugin that I can use to add an image behind the name box? I will be grateful with your answer.

Hi
@AkiJaline
You can do this easily:
WindowsBackImage must be BELOW YEP_messagecore
Go to the WindowsBackImage settings and enter a new parameter. Instead of using the drop-down list, go to text and type "Window_NameBox", choose your image, and that's it.

posts.author: AkiJaline
posts.body:
I did it as you told me and now it's working without any problems!
Thank you so much for your help!
